{{Quote|Welcome, passengers, to the White Nova. We'll be leaving the system in little over a standard hour and going to hyperspace for our trip to Coruscant. We hope that you have a pleasant flight. At this time, we request that all passengers make their way to their cabins and remain there until we make the jump. Thank you.|An announcement made to the passengers of the ''White Nova''|<ref name="Oblivion's Kiss">{{LivingForce|Oblivion's Kiss}}</ref>}}
The '''''White Nova''''' was a luxurious [[Luxury liner/Legends|star liner]] that was used to transport passengers during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In about [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the ''White Nova'' journeyed to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], from where it was scheduled to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and a number of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] were sent from the liner to the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] to pick up passengers. After selling a batch of tainted [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] to [[Merik Darou]], the assistant of [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Cularin's senator]], the [[drug dealer]] [[Kelkan D'vrosh]] was forced to go on the run, so he boarded the ''White Nova'' and planned to flee aboard the vessel to Coruscant. The [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of local freelance agents that sought to capture D'vrosh, secured places aboard the ''White Nova'' and boarded the vessel, to search for their target. On arrival aboard the liner, they were searched by the security specialist [[Esker]] and subsequently escorted to their personal quarters by the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C4-P5]]. An announcement was then made to the passengers of the ''White Nova'', to inform them that the ship was set to depart from the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] in about an hour's time, and that all passengers were requested to return to their cabins until the vessel had made they jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. After searching D'vrosh's cabin, the agents tracked the drug dealer to the ship's lower sections and captured him.
